Data:Librarian.json.label: Brancrug, March 7th, 1936
Data:Librarian.json.startdescription: 'There has been no Librarian at Hush House since the fire - seven years now. Suitable candidates are very difficult to find, but perhaps we have found one in you. Take care on your journey - the seas around Brancrug are treacherous...'
Data:Librarian.json.desc: 'She brought them to Brancrug Isle, which even then was a hidden place, to make a double foundation of nuns and monks, and become its first abbess: but she would admit none to the order who was a virgin, nor innocent of any crime. Since then, Brancrug has been a refuge for all the world might consider impure.'

Data:Library.altar.ascite.json.label: Altar: Ascite
Data:Library.altar.ascite.json.Desc: The Horned-Axe, who opens the way and keeps the threshold, is accounted the last of the Gods-from-Stone.

Data:Library.altar.atrium.json.label: Shrine: St Januarius
Data:Library.altar.atrium.json.Desc: St Januarius is the Name which was wounded; the Name of exceptions; the little god at the door.

Data:Library.altar.calicite.json.label: Calicite Altar
Data:Library.altar.calicite.json.Desc: The Red Grail, birth and appetite, denied and condemned by the clergy of the Sun for her temptress-role in the Sun's division. Those of us who oppose Eternity might instead give her thanks and praise. But cautiously.

Data:Library.altar.catacombs.json.label: Catacombs Altar
Data:Library.altar.catacombs.json.Desc: 'BONE IS THE MEMORY THAT DOES NOT DIE.'

Data:Library.altar.chancel.json.label: Shrine: the Chancel
Data:Library.altar.chancel.json.Desc: We do not name these Hours, but we acknowledge that together they are the Chancel, the Cruciate, and the Rode.

Data:Library.altar.chancel.mihail.json.label: Shrine: the Chancel
Data:Library.altar.chancel.mihail.json.desc: We do not name these Hours, but we acknowledge that together they are the Chancel, the Cruciate, and the Rode. Observe the indwelling light that was not here when the altar was first raised. [The Chancel Altar now admits Forge and Lantern intentions.]

Data:Library.altar.glorious.json.label: Shrine: the Madrugad
Data:Library.altar.glorious.json.Desc: The Madrugad is the Hour which cannot be unbalanced; which quells and quiets; which comes before the sun.

Data:Library.altar.lady.json.label: Altar of the Knot
Data:Library.altar.lady.json.Desc: History is woven; a knot is a testament.

Data:Library.altar.malachite.json.label: Altar: Malachite
Data:Library.altar.malachite.json.Desc: Honey, the blood; copper, the heart; yew, the root.

Data:Library.altar.radiant.json.label: Shrine: the Watchman
Data:Library.altar.radiant.json.Desc: The Watchman is the Hour which navigates; which illuminates; which is not compassionate.

Data:Library.altar.solar.json.label: Solar Altar
Data:Library.altar.solar.json.Desc: The Sun-in-Splendour is the Hour which was sundered; the Hour which is not conquered; the Hour from which proceed all the other Hours of the day. Or so the Church teaches.

Data:Library.altar.tentreto.json.label: Altar: St Tentreto
Data:Library.altar.tentreto.json.Desc: Saint Tentreto of the Deep Door, who is four times winged: for the Scīmafectra-kind; the Glaeterfleoge-kind; the Thritige-kind; for the kind-within.

Data:Library.altar.tentreto.offering.jso.label: Altar: St Tentreto
Data:Library.altar.tentreto.offering.jso.Desc: Saint Tentreto of the Deep Door, who is four times winged: for the Scīmafectra-kind; the Glaeterfleoge-kind; the Thritige-kind; for the kind-within. His fires have been fed with the offering from the West, as the setting Sun in the West once was fed with blood. [The altar now admits Heart intention, and provides Heart aspect.]
